title: Once MettleUp Plus limits are on, the Today home-screen widget still shows a free member the suggested weight and reps
what: MettleUp Plus says suggested weight and reps are paid. Inside a workout a free member gets no suggestion. The Today widget on the home screen writes up to two "what to beat" lines, each ending with the next weight and reps the app suggests, and it works them out with no Plus check at all. So a free member sees the paid suggestion on the home screen while the workout tells them it is locked. Today nothing changes, because the limits are switched off.
expected: With the limits on, a free member's Today widget shows last time's numbers only, or no what-to-beat lines, the same rule as the workout.
who: free members with the Today widget, once MettleUp Plus is switched on
fix_line: Give the widget's what-to-beat lines the same suggested-weights check the workout uses

items.reason: Switches of this area: workout sounds off, rest-over sound, ring through Do Not Disturb, reminders on/days/time, Health Connect send / weight / steps / sleep, remove Health Connect access, gym reminders and messages, leaderboard name, share with mates / trainers / machines, gym colour, watch Plus lock, Erase all data. features.json gives 36 features; entities.json holds no phone-local entity (all these live on the phone).

Should-read map: sounds off / sound / DND -> rest-over channel, own-ring fallback, watch buzz; Plus lock -> watch, widget suggestions, Up next; gym colour -> rest and workout cards, watch, widgets, reminders, gym icon; Health Connect off -> send, weight, steps, sleep tip; Erase -> reminders, Health Connect, widgets, icon shortcuts, gym icon, gym-side shares; Leave gym -> gym icon, widget Gym right now, gym reminders.

Crispy Curves: birthday 1/2, phone 2/2, check-in phone 1/2, app link 0/2, plan dates 1/1, trainer 0/2, batch 0/2. No feature of this area reads any of these gym fields; the widgets, gym icon and gym colour read only the phone's own gym link (shop/gymStore).

The phone-local fields this area needs (reminder days and time, Health Connect permissions, gym icon) are asked when the member turns the feature on or joins a gym; reminders fill in usual days until chosen.
No feature here depends on a gym-filled field, so the low fill of app link, trainer and batch does not reach this area.
No typed input box in this area (no TextInput, EditText or maxLength in the five folders). The nearest is weigh-ins from other apps, which are range-checked and rounded.
no input box in this area
